target_customer: Students preparing for standardized exams such as SAT, ACT, SHSAT, UTME, KCSE, NEET and YKS
problem: Students lack affordable personalized tutoring and endless tailored practice material for high-stakes exams.
business_model: Consumer subscription for AI tutor, question bank and practice exams

founders.name: Tyrone Davis III
founders.background_notes: Grew up in New York City.

founders.name: Guang Cui
founders.background_notes: Has taught algorithms, math, physics and music per YC profile.

technical_complexity.rationale: Building tutoring and question generation on top of foundation models is mostly application engineering, with effort in content quality and exam coverage.

defensibility.rationale: General chatbots and larger edtech brands can offer similar tutoring; exam specific content and distribution are the only differentiators.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Later 2026 comparison pages show strong incumbents and general AI assistants; no acquisition of Miyagi found.

market_need_then: Large exam-taking populations in several countries and the arrival of capable LLMs; the company's site claims 150K+ students.

identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly and student-focused, headline 'Ace the SAT. With your personal AI tutor.'

branding.brand_signature: 3D mascot characters on the website and app
branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN post in 2025 for the earlier YouTube to courses product; no merch or fan evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly consistent look and a memorable name, but no independent press or community evidence about the brand.

pivots.from: Turning YouTube videos into interactive courses
pivots.to: AI tutor and practice platform for standardized exam prep
pivots.why: Not stated by a source; inferred from earlier launch description versus current product.

outcome_analysis: Miyagi Labs joined YC in Winter 2025 with a YouTube to course tool and now sells an AI tutor for exam prep across several countries, with a mobile app and claims of 150K students. Funding appears small and unverified, and incumbents like Khan Academy plus general chatbots are the main threat. It is too early to call the outcome.
notes: Unverified: Round Funded and Caplight list about 500K USD pre-seed around March 2025 with YC and SBXi; Caplight page also carries an unrelated Series A banner that was ignored. No dated competitor sources near the batch were found; results were 2026 comparison pages. Name origin is not stated; a link to Mr. Miyagi is an unconfirmed inference and not recorded. The pivot is an inference and low confidence. Completeness pass: Round rests on aggregators (Employbl via Diffbot, VCBacked, Caplight) with differing investor lists; no press release found. A different Miyagi Labs (air traffic control) exists and was ignored.
